CheckTitle: Storage account is encrypted with CMK
Description: Verify that Storage Accounts use Customer-Managed Keys stored in Key Vault.
Risk: Default Microsoft-managed keys offer less control over key lifecycle.

Code.Other:
1. Enable a system-assigned managed identity on the storage account: az storage account update -n <account-name> -g <resource-group> --assign-identity
2. Grant the Key Vault 'Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User' role to the storage account identity: az role assignment create --role 'Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User' --assignee <identity-principal-id> --scope <keyvault-id>
3. Configure customer-managed key encryption on the storage account.

Recommendation.Text: Review and implement the recommended configuration for Storage Default Storage Account Encrypted With Cmk Not Stored In Storage Account.
